## Context / Problem

Discovered from majestic-depilatory-beetle. The advisory `sweep (windows)` job runs a maintained subset held green: tests known to fail on Windows are deselected through `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/text-encoding.args`. This bug owns that file: 133 tests in 58 modules, from the 5 scheduled runs at `b4e0d01b649` (2026-11-15/16).

`read_text()`/`open()`/`subprocess.run(text=True)` without `encoding=` use cp1252 on Windows, so UTF-8 bytes (an em dash round-tripped through cp1252 shows as 0x97; also 0x90/0x8f) fail with `UnicodeDecodeError`, and golden-output comparisons differ. Some sites may be in product code (`scripts/gen_env_registry.py`, `rebar explain`).

Largest modules: `tests/unit/test_gen_env_registry.py` (23), `tests/unit/test_alarm_actions_terraform.py` (17), `tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py` (7), `tests/unit/reconciler/state/test_binding_repository.py` (6), `tests/unit/test_subcall_class_selection.py` (5).

Example: `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_mcp_error_envelope.py::test_every_cli_literal_is_a_known_code`: `UnicodeDecodeError: 'utf-8' codec can't decode byte 0x97 in position 45: invalid start byte`.

## Approach

Pass `encoding="utf-8"` explicitly at the failing read/decode sites, product and test. Evaluate whether a lint rule (ruff `PLW1514`, unspecified-encoding) should hold the class closed.

## Scope

The failing product or test code for this class, plus `.github/windows-sweep-deselect/text-encoding.args` (remove each fixed line; delete the file and its `@` reference in `.github/workflows/test.yml` once empty).

## Testing

POSIX: the touched tests still pass under `make verify`. Windows: a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the change (scheduled, or `gh workflow run test.yml --ref main`) passes with the removed lines no longer deselected.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The class's root cause is recorded on this ticket with the evidence that confirmed it.
- [ ] Every line removed from `text-encoding.args` names a test that passed in a `sweep (windows)` run on main after the fix (run id recorded in a comment).
- [ ] `sweep (windows)` concludes `success` on that run.
compiled_state.title: Windows sweep: files and subprocess output decoded with the locale codec instead of UTF-8 (133 tests)
